## #1 — KurtF — 2018-05-05
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/12890/post-111861>

soloSelected

soloSelected is a macro script to switch the visibility of scene objects off, leaving only the selected object visible in the editor. Handy for clearing the clutter of big scenes, allowing you to focus on a single object.

In large scenes switching object's visibility back on would be tedious, so use showAll to switch them back.

Have been learning quite a bit about managing objects and their parameters. Hope these are useful.

View attachment soloSelected.js.zip

View attachment showAll.js.zip

Attachments: [soloSelected.js.zip](https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?attachments/32658/), [showAll.js.zip](https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?attachments/32659/)
